note: First published schema of the schedule files (BG-2), generated from ScheduleFileDocument in cli/src/core/schedule_store.ts on release/v1.3.0: a schedule record nexus-schedule (the operator's trigger, permission level, verifier and budgets, and the runner's bookkeeping of next slot, last fire, outcome and reported gaps), the pointer nexus-schedule-latest to its newest result, and the missed-run receipt nexus-schedule-missed. The files carry their version in the member 'version'; this ledger keys it as schema_version. Nothing was published before it. The readers refuse any other version and any unknown key, so every added, removed or changed member bumps SCHEDULE_FILE_VERSION.
